{
 "path": "programs/task-a99dd656.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Expand an ARC grid into a 2x2 arrangement of quarter-turn rotations."""
    a = [list(row) for row in grid]
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    return [a[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(len(a))] + [counterclockwise[r] + half[r] for r in range(len(a))]
"
